rating_note: Preliminary Dojo Elo measured over 200-hand, fixed-stack practice matches with isolated mirrored copies. Ratings are relative to this five-bot pool and are not comparable to public league Elo.

bots.name: Pebble
bots.description: A forgiving first opponent that checks or folds. Learn when to bet and when to take a free card.

bots.name: Spark
bots.description: An aggressive opponent that often bets without a strong hand. Learn to distinguish pressure from genuine strength.

bots.name: Anchor
bots.description: A patient opponent that hangs on to made hands. Look for opportunities when it gives up weaker hands.

bots.name: Mirage
bots.description: An opponent that estimates hand strength and mixes value bets with bluffs. Use the recap to investigate its decisions.

bots.name: Summit
bots.style: Reads betting patterns and weighs risk
bots.description: An adaptive opponent that estimates likely hands from betting patterns and compares several bet sizes. It balances chip gains with keeping opportunities to play.
